description: KSAB's sound stage: a blind render shell under a barrel roof, the call letters across the Meltwater Row side with one of them dark, a 7 the height of the wall on the Foundry Way end, and the transmitter mast over the plant deck. Its doors face into the lot: the elephant door at the scene dock, the stage door under a red ON AIR lamp, and a box office window with a card taped inside: TICKETS HERE.
name: KSAB-TV Studio Stage
